from pathlib import Path
import importlib,json,re,subprocess,hashlib
root=Path.cwd().parent
base="84e633fe53990951b96680295ab66daee60a8af2"
head=subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=root,text=True).strip()
paths=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only","-z",base,head],cwd=root).decode().strip("\0").split("\0"))
def tree(ref):
    result={}
    for row in subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-tree","-rz",ref],cwd=root).split(b"\0"):
        if row:
            info,name=row.split(b"\t",1)
            result[name.decode()]=info.split()[2]
    return result
old,new=tree(base),tree(head)
independent={p for p in old.keys()|new.keys() if p not in old or p not in new or old[p]!=new[p]}
assert paths==independent
protected=[p for p in paths if Path(p).name in ("DEBT-REGISTER.md","LEDGER.md")]
assert not protected
source=sorted(p for p in paths if p.startswith("policy-engine/src/"))
assert all(p.startswith("policy-engine/src/polisyos/data_forge/domains/academic/batch/") for p in source)
key=importlib.import_module("docs.superpowers.journals.corr-evidence.c1-capacity.capacity_common").load_credential().encode()
for path in paths:
    raw=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",head+":"+path],cwd=root)
    assert key not in raw and not re.search(rb"sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{12,}",raw),"credential_scan_refused"
    if path.endswith(".json"):
        assert key.decode() not in repr(json.loads(raw)),"decoded_credential_scan_refused"
print(json.dumps({"base":base,"head":head,"complete_changed_identity_count":len(paths),"independent_identity_sets_equal":True,"changed_production_paths":source,"protected_register_changes":protected,"raw_and_decoded_secret_scan":"pass","identity_digest":hashlib.sha256("\n".join(sorted(paths)).encode()).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True))
